title: Cloud-hosted platform for authoring, approving and distributing safety data sheets
description: The contracting authority requires a software as a service platform for SDS authoring, GHS hazard classification, chemical labelling, chemical inventory management and distribution of safety data sheets to employees and customers. The solution must be cloud based and browser based, with API integration, single sign on and multi-site access. Subscription licensing, implementation services, data migration and support and maintenance are required. Regulatory content updates for REACH and CLP are in scope.

title: SaaS EHS management system with incident, inspection and audit modules
description: The Authority seeks a vendor hosted platform covering incident management, near miss reporting, inspection management, audit management, corrective and preventive action tracking and risk assessment. Cloud deployment is required. Mobile and web access, role based access and reporting and dashboards are mandatory. Annual subscription with support and maintenance.

title: Chemical inventory and safety data sheet management software
description: Sources sought for a commercial off the shelf web based platform providing chemical inventory, safety data sheet management, hazard communication and employee access to safety data sheets. The Government will consider a software as a service subscription. Data migration from the legacy chemical register is required.
buyer_name: DEPT OF DEFENSE - DEPT OF THE ARMY

title: Occupational health and safety management system software with optional on-premises deployment
description: The Council requires an occupational health and safety management system covering incident reporting, permit to work, contractor safety and audit management. Suppliers may propose a cloud or on premises deployment; an optional locally hosted deployment is also acceptable. Integration with existing systems and configuration and training are required.

title: Consultancy for implementation and configuration of an EHS software platform
description: Request for expression of interest for consultancy services to implement, configure and support an environment health and safety software platform, including chemical management, incident management and inspection management modules, user training and data migration. The platform will be hosted by the vendor as a managed cloud service.

title: GHS compliant SDS authoring software / Logiciel de rédaction de fiches de données de sécurité conforme au SGH
description:
Supply of a subscription software solution for SDS authoring, hazard classification and chemical labelling, including regulatory content for WHMIS and GHS.

Fourniture d'une solution logicielle par abonnement pour la rédaction de fiches de données de sécurité, la classification des dangers et l'étiquetage des produits chimiques.

title: Contratação de plataforma em nuvem para gestão de fichas de dados de segurança e gestão de produtos químicos
description: Contratação de empresa especializada no fornecimento de software como serviço (SaaS) para gestão de fichas de dados de segurança, inventário de produtos químicos, classificação de perigos e gestão de incidentes de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente. Inclui implantação, migração de dados, integração por API e suporte e manutenção.
buyer_name: Secretaria de Meio Ambiente do Estado de São Paulo

title: Beschaffung eines Gefahrstoffmanagement-Systems (Sicherheitsdatenblätter) - Betrieb ausschließlich im Rechenzentrum des Auftraggebers
description: Die Vergabestelle benötigt ein System für Gefahrstoffmanagement und Sicherheitsdatenblatt-Verwaltung. All application components must reside on the buyer's network and the software must be installed on customer servers. Cloud hosting is prohibited. Wartung und Support sind Bestandteil des Auftrags.

title: Supply of laboratory chemicals and reagents
description: Framework agreement for the supply of laboratory chemicals, solvents and reagents. The supplier must provide an SDS for every chemical delivered and safety data sheets shall be provided with each delivery in the national language. Deliveries are called off monthly.

title: Health and safety training and consultancy services
description: Provision of health and safety training services and appointment of a safety advisor for construction site safety supervision across the estate. No software is required; the supplier will deliver classroom and on-site training only.

title: Supply of personal protective equipment and safety signage
description: Purchase of safety boots, protective clothing, safety helmets and workplace safety signage for regional depots.

title: Software defined storage (SDS) capacity expansion
description: Procurement of software defined storage capacity for the data centre, including SDS management console licences, three years of support and professional services for migration.

title: Chemical compliance and safety data sheet management platform (private cloud)
description: The authority requires a chemical compliance platform with safety data sheet management, poison centre notification and exposure scenario support. The platform shall be operated in a government cloud provided by the buyer. ISO 27001 certification is required. Implementation, configuration and annual support are included.

title: Cloud EHS incident management platform (closed)
description: Invitation for bids for a cloud hosted EHS incident management platform including near miss reporting, inspection management and audit management. Submission of bids has closed.
